content.rendered:
Get most or all Dream League Soccer Kits (DLS Kits) for season 2020 – 2021 URL to import into DLS Apk game for Android or download your favorite team kits and logos.

After installing DLS Apk, there will be need to add real Kits for your favorite team, so that they can look real like a football team. This kits can only work on the new DLS 2021 apk, which was released on November 5, 2020.

But you can also check for Dream league 2019 and FTS series kits by visiting this section of my website – DLS Kits Category

Kits for Dream League Soccer game series can be used or Imported as Home Kit, Away Kits, Third kits, Goal Keeper Home and Away Kits including logos using the copied URLs below, there is also alternate kits which you can use to further beautify the appearance of your team.

Below are the list of kits that you can import into latest official new DLS 2020 new soccer mobile game for Android
